title: Characterization and scaling limit of three-dimensional loop-erased random walk and random-walk loop-catchers
summary: Random-walk loop-catchers (RWLC) are a one-parameter family of random subsets of the trace of a random walk, recently introduced in [Cai 2026, arXiv:2607.18070], which interpolates between loop-erased random walk (LERW) and the full walk trace, satisfying a recovery property. We prove that the continuous version of this recovery property uniquely characterizes the scaling limit of LERW and RWLC in three dimensions, using a Green-function test via entangled multipath LERW, as outlined in [Cai 2026, arXiv:2607.18070].
